official_statement_rationale: I vote for a reduction of the repo rate by 25 basis points and a change in the stance to neutral. With core inflation at a benign 3.10%, the current real policy rate is becoming excessively restrictive and risks stifling the 6.80% GVA growth momentum. The headline CPI of 4.75% is driven primarily by food price volatility, which is a supply-side phenomenon that monetary policy is ill-equipped to address without causing collateral damage to the broader economy. Given the output gap is only marginally positive at 0.40%, maintaining a stance of 'withdrawal of accommodation' is no longer appropriate. We must shift to a neutral stance to signal that the policy rate is sufficiently high to anchor expectations without acting as an unnecessary drag on the recovery.
